title: A New Circumcision at Gilgal
description: The Lord commanded Joshua to make flint knives and circumcise the new generation of Israelites at the Hill of Foreskins, since those born during the wilderness wanderings had not been circumcised. After the people were healed, the Lord said that He had rolled away the disgrace of Egypt from them, and the place was called Gilgal [ref:Jos 5:2-9|Joshua 5:2-9].
